name: gd6.exe
source:
In the room of the school electronics club there has been an old, non-working computer for a long time. Two enthusiasts couldn't just look at it and fixed it. When they started the computer, they found a mysterious program that could answer any question entered by the user. What can this program do? Where does it get the answers to questions?

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/5-1-0-2695]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
学校电子俱乐部的房间里有一台旧的、不能工作的电脑已经很长时间了。两个爱好者不能只是看看它并修复它。当他们启动计算机时，他们发现了一个神秘的程序，可以回答用户输入的任何问题。这个程序能做什么？它从哪里得到问题的答案？

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/5-1-0-2695]Anivis[/url]]
